description_en: Uploads a refresh or prefetch file to improve access speed

kebab_example: aliyun esa upload-file --site-id 1234567890000 --url https://XXXXXX.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/_prefix_account_uid_hash --type file --upload-task-name purge_task_2024_11_11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadFile

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the refresh or prefetch file stored in OSS. The Url parameter accepts URLs in two formats:

Transit URL (recommended): automatically generated through the file transfer feature of the ESA console or SDK.

OSS pre-signed HTTPS URL: generated after you upload the file to an authorized OSS bucket. The isFileTransferUrl field specifies whether to use the transit URL mode
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储刷新或者预热文件的URL。Url 参数接受两种格式的 URL：

中转 URL（推荐），通过 ESA 控制台或 SDK 的文件传输功能自动生成。

OSS pre-signed HTTPS URL，需将文件上传至有权限的 OSS Bucket 后生成。isFileTransferUrl 字段标识是否使用中转 URL 模式
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
The type of the refresh or prefetch task. Valid values:
file (default): file refresh.
preload: file prefetch.
directory: directory refresh.
ignoreParams: parameter-ignored refresh
parameters.help_zh:
刷新/预热任务类型，取值：
file（默认值）：文件刷新。
preload：文件预热。
directory：目录刷新。
ignoreParams：去参数刷新
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the upload task
parameters.name: upload_task_name

UploadId.description_en: The ID of the file upload task. You can use this ID to submit or query the task
UploadId.description_zh: 文件上传任务ID，后续可通过此ID提交、查询任务
